chunks: It yields its fruit at all times, by the leave of its Lord. And Allah presents the parables to the people, perhaps that they may remember.

key_terms.بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا: by the leave/permission of its Lord

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the parable of the good tree in Surah Ibrahim?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a metaphor for the Ahl al-Bayt or the righteous believer, whose spiritual fruits are abundant and consistent through divine grace (idhn). It serves as a profound parable (mathal) urging humanity to reflect on the connection between steadfast faith and continuous spiritual productivity, contrasting with the barrenness of disbelief.
